subject: CloudFlux marketplace inquiry — quick intro and schedule
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@cloudflux.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-28T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Interest in Redwood listing on GCP Marketplace — quick intro?

Hi Jordan,

We came across Redwood Inference on the GCP Marketplace (nice listing — congrats). I set up a trial workspace yesterday to test model latency for our reranking pipeline.

We're evaluating options to replace our current on-prem GPU inference stack — three main goals: better latency for short queries, lower per-token cost, and a simpler rollout path for model updates.

Would love a 20–30 minute intro to understand product fit and run through a short demo. I’m Samir (Head of ML @ CloudFlux).

A few quick facts:
- Prototype traffic: ~50 qps, bursts to 200 qps
- Typical prompt length: 60–150 tokens
- Data residency: US east (no PII)

Thanks — is someone available early next week?

Best,
Samir Patel
Head of Machine Learning
CloudFlux
samir@cloudflux.io
+1 (415) 555-0198
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>

Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-28T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interest in Redwood listing on GCP Marketplace — quick intro?

Hi Samir — thanks for reaching out and for trying the trial. Glad the marketplace listing made it easy.

Quick context: I run inbound SDR & technical touch with our cloud marketplace leads. Irene (cc'd) will help coordinate a short intro/demo; Monica (our AE) will join for deeper roadmap / pricing discussions.

Before we lock a time, two quick Qs so we tailor the session:
- Are you most focused on latency improvements for single-request p99, or cost per token at scale?
- Any constraints around quantization or model flavor (open Llama-style models vs. proprietary)?

If helpful, here are a couple of 30-minute windows next week (PDT):
- Tue May 3 — 10:00–10:30 or 15:00–15:30
- Wed May 4 — 09:00–09:30 or 13:00–13:30

If you prefer self-serve first, we can send an agenda + sample prompts to run on your trial and reconvene with results. Otherwise Irene will share a Calendly link.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Senior SDR Lead, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

Hi Samir — Irene here from Redwood. Thanks for taking the trial — happy to coordinate.

I created a short scheduling link so you can pick a time that fits your calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood/intro-30 (30 min).

Proposed agenda (30m):
- 5m quick intros + goals
- 10m demo: endpoint behavior (latency/cold startup/streaming)
- 10m deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
- 5m next steps / checklist (POC, security prefill, pricing)

I see Jordan already suggested Tue May 3 and Wed May 4. Could you pick one or reply with a preferred slot/timezone? Also — if you have a short prefill (sample queries / traffic profile), you can attach it here; we’ll pre-run a few checks to make the meeting productive.

Thanks,

See you on Tue.
